content:
alex.t: Kicking off a staged rollout for model-serving v2.4.3 to EU. Target window 2026-04-02 14:00-16:00 UTC. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Anyone see capacity constraints? I'll queue deploy-bot when we have thumbs.

deploy-bot: Job queued: rollout/1772012345
payload:
```
env: prod
regions: [eu]
model: model-serving:v2.4.3
canary: 5
steps: [5,25,100]
rollback_version: model-serving:v2.4.2
change_window: 2026-04-02T14:00:00Z/2026-04-02T16:00:00Z
```

maya.sre: Quick capacity check: EU dedicated pool 8xA100 nodes, current utilization 62%, expected headroom 20% for steady load. Burst capacity +2 nodes available in us-east partner pool if needed (adds ~30ms). APAC is tight at 88% right now so avoid APAC expansion.

tj.platform: LGTM on numbers. Suggest we pin fallback model to m-small-quant in canary policy in case latency regresses. Also add rate-limit bump for canary keys to 50rps per token.

eva.prod: Release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-04-02-model-v2-4-3 (minor perf improvements, KV cache hotfix). I've added rollback steps and runbook.

alex.t: Good. deploy-bot, please start canary at 14:00 UTC. Keep canary at 5% for 30m, then hold for metrics. If error rate >0.5% or p95 latency +15% over baseline -> auto-rollback to v2.4.2.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job rollout/1772012345 will start at 2026-04-02T14:00:00Z. Health checks: traffic-shift, error-rate, latency-p95. Auto-rollback configured.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor. Pager policy enabled for error spikes >1% sustained 3m. Also I'll set a temporary alert threshold for cache-miss >10%.

maya.sre: One more: run a preflight load test at 13:20 UTC against a mirror of EU pool (script: `scripts/preflight/capacity_check.sh --region eu --duration 300`). I ran it earlier, results attached: 5k rps stable, p95 120ms.

alex.t: Perfect. If all green we'll progress to 25% at 14:40 UTC. Everyone set on rollback owner? @maya.sre you own rollback, @tj.platform you own canary config, @eva.prod you own release notes/public comms.

maya.sre: Confirmed. I'll hold manual rollback if auto doesn't trigger.

tj.platform: I'll watch metrics dashboards and push canary increase when green. :thumbsup:

eva.prod: I'll post status in #prod-status when canary starts and update release notes with any anomalies.

alex.t: Thanks. I'll leave the thread open for updates. :rocket:
